answer_1.quote: Simultaneous Machine Translation (SiMT) aims to generate target translation before receiving the whole source sentence...

answer_2.quote: We utilize BLEU to measure the translation quality, and Average Lagging (AL) for latency. Besides, we use the Hallucination Rate (HR) for analyzing hallucinations.

answer_4.quote: To further evaluate the effect of KD-SiMT on reducing hallucinations in SiMT, we conduct a manual evaluation on Zh→En SiMT task.
answer_4.guideline: we randomly sample 100 sentences respectively in the outputs of wait-k and MMA and calculate the percentage of sentences exhibiting hallucinations
